title: Your profile
summary: The person's own profile from the Você tab: the name and photo people see in chats (the Matrix profile), the @, the link and QR code, and the entry to the public profile. The name passes the reserved-name check before it is saved.

nameProblem.description: reserved: the normalised name is in registries/reserved-names.json and the account is not a verified company (security.md rule 8).

phase.description: saving: Client.setDisplayName or the photo upload runs.

editName.effect: Sets displayName and runs the local reserved-name check.

saveName.effect: Client.setDisplayName with the trimmed name. Off while nameProblem is not none.

changePhoto.effect: Opens the system photo picker or camera, crops to a square, re-encodes as JPEG and calls Client.uploadAvatar.

openShare.effect: Opens profile-share. Only with a handle.

notes: The Matrix profile goes to every chat the person is in. The public profile (ADR 0041) is separate and opt-in; the app fills it from the Matrix profile the first time.

Reserved names: NameNormalizer.normalize and NameNormalizer.reservedCategory (iOS and Android), cases in test-vectors/normalization.json. The server and the other apps check again; the local check only gives early feedback.
A company account (ADR 0087) edits the company name and logo here; its seal and legal name come from the badge, never from this screen (cnpj-badge).
The Matrix ID is never shown (ADR 0013). Without a handle the @ row shows bipe_trust_step_profile_add_handle.
Badge-lookalike emoji next to the name (bipe_warning_name_lookalike_emoji, trust-ui.md) need a shared registry first; not in this spec.
Bipe logic: BipeAPIClient.myHandle and myProfile (iOS), BipeApiClient.myProfile, BipeHandleRow, BipePublicProfileRow (Android).
